phrase: a Shilajit and Ayurvedic Supplements Brand
verdict: Yes, with careful claims. Zingavita from Chandigarh pitched modern ayurvedic supplements including shilajit on Shark Tank India Season 4, but didn't get a deal. Shilajit is popular, but quality varies widely and heavy metal testing is essential.
angle: Shilajit and ashwagandha sell strongly online. Purity and heavy-metal tests build trust. AYUSH licensing and careful claims are required.
